sources.note: 2024 avg 3:10 (190 min) with pitch clock; other source says 2:58 (178 min). We use 168 min (2:48) as conservative radio window without extra innings. Pre+post adds 30 min pre + 15 post = 210 min total on-air.
Average 3:12 (192 min) from kickoff to final whistle per Nielsen/NFL. Halftime 12 min (13:30 expanded for Super Bowl). Pregame 60 min, post 30 min => 282 min Westwood One window.
2024 avg 3:27 (207 min) FBS per NCAA tracking. Bowl/CFP avg 3:29.5. Halftime 20 min. Pregame 45 min => 252 min window.

methodology: Free minute = no live radio broadcast ongoing. We compute broadcast window = avg game duration + pregame. For calendar-day vacancy we simplify to full day blocked if any game that day; intraday free hours are shown in calendar page using exact windows.
